chip.description: OPNB2: the YM2610 with six FM channels instead of four, retaining the SSG, ADPCM-A and ADPCM-B sections (taxonomy TB3 keeps the whole part in sound-fm).
chip.notes: MAME 0.288 device ym2610b, full name "YM2610B OPNB2", implemented in src/devices/sound/ymopn.cpp alongside the YM2610 (OPNB).
